small_guidance:
- Add larger BLOCK_M configs (e.g. BLOCK_M=256/BLOCK_N=128, BLOCK_M=128/BLOCK_N=256) with num_warps=8 and num_stages=3-4 to better amortize the K=72 inner reduction; also try BLOCK_N=64 with BLOCK_M=512 since OC=64 fits exactly in one tile and most parallelism comes from the 16k spatial dim.
- Since OC=64 always fits in one BLOCK_N tile, drop the pid_n grid dim (set BLOCK_N=64 fixed) and use the freed program-id axis to tile batch×spatial together — this avoids the cdiv(OC,64)=1 wasted grid axis and lets the scheduler pack more CTAs.
- K_PAD=128 wastes ~44% of the GEMM-K work (real K=72). Split the loop into a real-K inner loop with BLOCK_K=72 padded to 72→use mask only on K tail, or unroll the IC=8/KH=3/KW=3 reduction explicitly so unused lanes don't enter tl.dot.
large_guidance:
- Rewrite as a direct conv (no im2col gather padding to K_PAD=128): one program per (N, output-tile), with the KH·KW·IC=72 reduction unrolled as a fixed nested loop over (kh, kw) loading IC=8 contiguous channels each step. This eliminates the 44% padding waste in the current K_PAD=128 GEMM and lets each MAC be useful.
- Keep NHWC input layout but store weight as (OC, KH, KW, IC) so each (kh,kw) step is a small [BLOCK_M, IC] × [IC, OC] matmul (IC=8 → use tl.dot with BLOCK_K=8 or hand-rolled FMA across IC); accumulate into a [BLOCK_M, OC=64] register tile. Since OC=64 fits in one tile, no N-tiling is needed.
- Fuse div + leaky_relu into the epilogue (already done) and pre-scale weight+bias by 1/divisor at init (already done). Consider writing output in NHWC and only permuting back if downstream requires NCHW — or skip permute entirely if the benchmark accepts NHWC-equivalent strides.
